sections.body: Several matchups decide this game. Start with the blitz: Minnesota sends heavy pressure on 72.3% [mc1] of 336 [mc2] dropbacks, and ATL ranks 28th [mc3] in EPA per play at -0.08 [mc4]. Get the ball out quickly with screens and hot reads. Next is the run game into a light box: Minnesota averages 6.6 [mc5] defenders in the box on run plays and allows a 36.7% [mc6] run success rate. Then comes Jefferson, who takes 25.7% [mc7] of Minnesota targets, against an ATL pass defense allowing 0.08 [mc8] EPA per pass play. Give him a safety over the top. Finally, the red zone: Minnesota has scored on 46.2% [mc9] of red-zone drives on 26 [mc10] drives, and Reichard has made 63.6% [mc11] of long tries on 11 [mc12] attempts. Keep Minnesota out of the end zone.
